exceptions.rationale: ROCm SDPA kernel dispatch and capability fencing are still colocated; this exact cap prevents growth pending a backend-owned split.
Embedded Metal shader source is generated-style backend material rather than orchestration; its exact physical-line count is nevertheless capped against growth.
The inference state machine still combines prefill, decode, cache, and sampling orchestration; splitting it requires preserving request-lifecycle invariants.
ROCm graph admission, capture, replay, telemetry, and recovery share one safety authority today; this exception is a strict non-growth ceiling.
Resident Vulkan decode owns tightly coupled shader state and lifecycle validation; this exact ceiling forbids further consolidation into the file.

The training API owns OpenEnv corpus admission, including the exact behavior-policy match required before no-importance-correction GRPO; the added focused invariant test stays beside that admission boundary and this exact cap prevents unrelated growth.
The sole production scheduler intentionally owns one state machine, but its policy and resource helpers still need reviewed extraction before this exception can shrink.
OpenEnv command schemas, dispatch, and tests live in their owned module; this exact ceiling adds only the central top-level registration and user-facing navigation.

OpenEnv credential policy lives in its own module; this residual increase covers the typed re-export, startup validation hook, redacted effective-config insertion, and a complete dynamic-field audit. The cap remains below its prior 11442-line ceiling.

Application state is the authority for resolving an OpenEnv rollout policy to immutable base-model, inference-config, runtime, and adapter-content revisions; collection and admission share this one canonical identity boundary, and the exact cap blocks unrelated ownership growth.

Training execution and publication share the adapter mutation barrier; OpenEnv adds a final behavior-policy revision check and an immutable trainer-local adapter snapshot under that same lock so admitted rollouts cannot race mutable weights. The exact cap forbids unrelated growth.
CUDA storage now includes the reviewed host-upload capture-arena interception required to keep CUDA graph inputs device-resident; this exact ceiling prevents unrelated backend growth.

On-policy distillation still combines data flow, resume, teacher, and optimization orchestration; the one-line increase explicitly marks its non-OpenEnv training-data receipt while preserving the exact cap.
Capability policy tests now live with the policy owner; this file retains only the generated-style Vulkan kernel registry and embedded shader source authority at its lower exact ceiling.
